cohort: 15,892 women who underwent primary caesarean section and had a catheter placed
finding: The study found that catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTIs) are common after caesarean section in Ukraine, with a prevalence rate of 13.6%, and many cases are caused by multidrug-resistant pathogens.
mod_finding: This study specifically focused on catheter-associated urinary tract infections after cesarean sections and did not compare outcomes across different modes of delivery.
